g.title: legend
g.text: PK primary key · FK foreign key · UQ unique · * NOT NULL
crow's foot = many · bar = exactly one · circle = optional
Colour = module / schema (one schema per module)
FKs to iam.app_user (created_by, approved_by ...) omitted for clarity
